placements.title: The analytics pipeline's database is being replaced by a columnar engine chosen for query speed
placements.frame: What database does the analytics pipeline run on, what performance does the choice buy over the incumbent, and when does the migration land?
placements.why: The envelope's six expressions all carry one subject: a named vendor (Zypherion) chosen for the analytics pipeline, justified by a quantified columnar-query gain over the current setup, with a scheduled migration window. That is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (benchmarks, migration milestones, incumbent retirement), not a one-time fact — the 15x figure and the Q3 2026 date are evidence carried by the position, never leaves of their own. Nothing exists in the supplied structure to reuse: Thematic, Documents, and Unplaced doors are all empty and EXISTING STRATA holds nothing, so this mints standalone with no lineage and no parent.
